trend.method: Close vs SMA 20 vs SMA 50: uptrend if close > SMA 20 > SMA 50, downtrend if close < SMA 20 < SMA 50, otherwise mixed.
trend.label: downtrend

levels.method: Swing highs/lows (a candle's high or low is the extreme of the 3 candles on each side) over the last 100 candles. Sorted by price, a swing point joins the current zone when it is within 1 x ATR 14 (the average true range at the last candle, 101.854 in price units) of the zone's lowest swing point, so no zone is wider than that. Each zone spans its lowest to highest grouped swing point; support lies wholly below the last close and resistance wholly above it. Levels are approximate zones, not exact prices.

stories.impact_reason: Reports the Federal Reserve advancing proposals to implement the GENIUS Act for stablecoins, a regulatory step that may be relevant to the broader crypto market structure.

stories.title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
stories.summary: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.
stories.impact_reason: Describes newly unveiled Fed rules on stablecoin reserves and capital, which may be relevant to how dollar-backed tokens operate market-wide.

stories.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
stories.summary: The U.S derivatives regulator is grinding away at further guidance that welcomes tokenization and blockchain recordkeeping as regular industry elements.
stories.impact_reason: Reports the CFTC permitting commodities firms to invest in tokenized assets and use blockchain records, which may be relevant to institutional adoption of digital assets.

findings.rules: Deterministic rules: the trend sets the candidate (uptrend -> BUY, downtrend -> SELL, mixed -> WAIT). Evidence scores points (trend 2, MACD 1, RSI 1, zone break 2, volume up to 2, news up to 2). BUY/SELL needs no blocking factor, enough points and a clear margin over the opposing side; otherwise WAIT. Triggers and invalidations are closes on the analyzed timeframe at computed zone bounds or moving averages. No probabilities, targets or percentage stops.
